title: Snoozing alarms on full Android watch
symptom: The user finds it very fiddly to get to the side menu to choose the snooze option on a full Android smart watch (KOSPET Prime), especially in the middle of the night, and asks if there is a way to use the side buttons to snooze alarms.
evidence_quote: is there a way of using the buttons on the side of the full Android smart watch (KOSPET Prime) to snooze alarms? It very fiddly to get to the side menu to choose the snooze option (especially in the middle of the night when half asleep!)
